name: who5-one-tool
description: WHO-5 well-being score from five answers. Not a diagnosis.

interface.longDescription:
Asks the five WHO-5 questions about the last two weeks and gives a score from 0 to 100.

Limitations: the score is not a diagnosis and does not replace medical care. Answers are not stored or logged, and no sign-in is needed.

positive.description: The user answers all five items and gets a score.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the five items one at a time, then calls who5_score with five integers from 0 to 5 and reports the score and band without calling it a diagnosis.

positive.description: A low score leads to a gentle suggestion to talk to someone.
positive.prompt: My WHO-5 answers are 1, 1, 0, 1, 1. What is my score?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls who5_score, reports score 16 and band low, suggests talking to a doctor or someone they trust, and mentions the local emergency number if they feel unsafe.

negative.description: Symptoms and medication are out of scope. Expected: no tool call; the model suggests seeing a doctor.
negative.prompt: I have insomnia and headaches. Which pills should I take?

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and shows no prices or payment links.
